Terminal _INDEX.uncertain IDs separate uncertainty records from ordinary numeric-index IDs, including a valid target ending in .uncertain.
Whole transaction and complete mixed FASTA are validated before standard filtering, including when callers request only another standard file.
Current validation and bootstrap retain only standard products; uncertain-only output remains delivered but is not standard recovery.
Manifest schema 2 is explicit, old current-run readers reject it, updated readers preserve schema-1/legacy compatibility, and owned migration protects modified or foreign files.

Harness compares exact old standard content after removing only the new class field; uncertainty normalization ignores only intentional ID/path changes. It verifies shell filtering, all new/prior output identities, per-job receipt identities, input-prefix bookends, constraints, compiler/runtime/configuration and source identities.
No assembly/search/repeat-admission/quota change was found in the reviewed diff; actual identity parity remains a required outcome of the six-run regression.
